subject: klipspringer antelope
title: This Antelope Lands All Four Hooves on a Coin-Sized Ledge

scenes.text: This antelope can land on a rock ledge the size of a large coin. With all four feet.
The klipspringer lives on cliffs and boulders in Africa, and weighs about as much as a small dog.
It walks on the very tips of its hooves, like a ballet dancer.
Each hoof has a hard rim and a rubbery centre that grips rock like a suction cup.
So it can leap ten to twelve feet and land on a spot about four centimetres wide.
And while one partner eats, the other stands guard and whistles when a predator comes.

description:
The klipspringer is a small African antelope that stands on the tips of its hooves, which have rubbery centres and hard rims for grip.
It can leap 10 to 12 feet and land with all four feet on a projection the size of a silver dollar. Pairs take turns standing guard.
Which climber should we cover next?
first_comment: Its fur is made of hollow, brittle hairs. Which animal is the best climber you know?
